# Houses SoldByStreet

> Free street-level UK house price search. Enter a postcode and see what homes
> actually sold for on that street, year by year, with year-on-year trend,
> transaction counts and individual sale history. All data is HM Land Registry
> Price Paid Data (England & Wales), released under the Open Government Licence
> v3. Coverage 2018 onwards. Run by Trace Lab Studio LTD.

## Key pages

- [Home / search](https://soldbystreet.co.uk/): search by full postcode, postcode
  sector, or street name; returns per-street median price, year-on-year change,
  sale counts, price per square metre, and a map.
- [Sold prices in SW6 (Fulham)](https://soldbystreet.co.uk/sold-prices/sw6): a
  worked area page — region stats, streets with the strongest multi-year growth,
  price trend by year, featured-street charts.
- [Guides](https://soldbystreet.co.uk/guides): how to read sold prices, make an
  offer, and sense-check an asking price.

## Data & method

- Source: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data,
  https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/price-paid-data
- Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0
- Scope: England and Wales only. Scotland and Northern Ireland are not covered.
- Figures are the registered sale price; street figures are the median per
  calendar year.
